banner.where: lib/screens/today_screen.dart:364 and :413 (_InlineAd -> AglAdBanner at :655-660) and lib/screens/dial_screen.dart:363 (after Genres)

interstitial.why: It fires on every tab change (lib/screens/main_shell.dart:104-111 _goToTab -> AglAds.onTransition()), and nothing checks whether a station is playing; agl_ads only applies the warm-up/3-minute cap (packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ads.dart:140-153). Switching tabs while listening is the normal way to use the app, so a video interstitial can start over the live stream. That breaks the founder rule that ads must never interrupt playback unexpectedly. (Whether the ad ducks or pauses the just_audio stream was not checked on a device.) Remove it, or at minimum gate the call on !AudioPlayerService.instance.isPlaying (getter declared at lib/services/audio_player_service.dart:61). Note: spec radiotune.md:187 said onTransition 'stays'; this recommendation follows the newer 2026-10-14 founder rule.

native.why: A browse/discovery list of stations: up to 60 stations per genre, country or language (genre_stations_screen.dart:79-82 limit: 60), and it has no ad today. A small template after every 8th StationTile is a natural native slot. Use small, not medium: the small template has no media view, so it cannot play video audio over the radio. Keep the bottom padding (150) and the MiniPlayer bottomSheet (:148-149,160) clear of the ad. Map the index so 'Shuffle all' and the playStation queue (:117-125,155-156) still get the plain _stations list without ad rows. Optional second slot, same rule: Dial station search results (dial_screen.dart:233-244, up to 40 results, :131). No native on Log, Library favourites/recent (the user's own lists), Now Playing, Car mode or Settings (spec radiotune.md:187).

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none (no quota/premium/IAP found in lib or pubspec.yaml)
rewarded.why: Every feature (alarm, sleep timer, car mode, favourites, log) is core and free, and there is no premium tier or free quota to extend. A rewarded video also plays audio, which would cut into playback. Nothing honest to reward.
